items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Sondernutzungserlaubnis
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026; no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the letter date counts as the posting day. Delivery fiction for a simple letter from a general authority (not a tax office, § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG): 4th day after posting, counting calendar days, day of posting not counted: 20 Fri, 21 Sat, 22 Sun, 23 Mon → deemed delivered Mon 23.11.2026. For general (non-tax) authorities the delivery day does not move even if it fell on a weekend/holiday; here it is a Monday anyway, so no adjustment needed. One-month Widerspruch period runs from the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23 Dec 2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Hamburg, so the deadline stands unchanged.
